question: If the surface area of a sphere increases by 21%, by what percentage does its volume increase?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area ∝ r² and Volume ∝ r³

Ratio of Surface Area = 100 : 121

Ratio of Radius = √100 : √121 = 10 : 11

Ratio of Volume = 10³ : 11³ = 1000 : 1331

Percentage increase in volume = (1331 − 1000) ÷ 1000 × 100 = 33.1%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.1%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Increase in surface area = 21%

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³
